paragraphs.text: No. 16 Mississippi State fell 31–0 at No. 22 LSU on Saturday, Oct. 17, in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, according to the Bulldogs’ official game recap.
LSU built a 21–0 halftime lead with three touchdown passes, then added a field goal and another touchdown pass in the third quarter. Mississippi State did not score.

Quarterback Billy Puckett and running back Kolin Wilson made their first collegiate starts. Mississippi State’s postgame notes list Puckett with 16 completions on 26 attempts for 121 yards and Wilson with 75 rushing yards on 18 carries.
